# googleworkspace_domains (Data Source)

Lists the domains registered on the Google Workspace account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_domains" "this" {}

# The primary domain on the account.
output "primary_domain" {
  value = one([
    for d in data.googleworkspace_domains.this.domains : d.domain_name if d.is_primary
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `customer_id` (String) The customer ID the domains were read for.
- `domains` (Attributes List) The domains on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain_name` (String) The fully qualified domain name.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary domain.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain is verified.
